og_title: AI has started breaking in on its own — Warning Shots: see what’s coming, know what it means for you
og_desc: Severe AI incidents went from 3 to 12 in a year. In 48% of this year's real-world cases the AI itself did the acting. 138 incidents since 2023, scored 0–100 and sourced. Live tracking of PHP2Shell, 20 dated forecasts, and what officials have said. Updated Oct 24, 8:30 AM ET.

n.title: Fortune: the PHP flaws may have been exploited before disclosure; OpenAI expands its Daybreak cyber program
n.summary: Fortune reports hackers may have exploited the PHP flaws before disclosure and that OpenAI is expanding its Daybreak cyber-defense program.
